# Tutorial Sheet 3

## Question 1

A ball is thrown straight up at $20\,\mathrm{m/s}$.

(a) Find the greatest height it reaches.

(b) Find its time of flight.

## Question 2

$\nabla \cdot \mathbf{B} = 0$ for a dipole field.
(a) Show this by taking the divergence term by term.

## Solutions

1(a) $h = v^2 / 2g = 20.4\,\mathrm{m}$

1(b) $t = 2v/g = 4.08\,\mathrm{s}$

2 Write $\mathbf{B$ in components and differentiate.
